chapter.title: Farmer's Delight
chapter.subtitle: Start with a Flint Knife and follow the chain

quests.title: Flint Knife
quests.subtitle: Your kitchen tool
description: A Flint Knife cuts ingredients and harvests from crops. It is the first tool of cooking.
Next: a Cutting Board to prepare ingredients.

quests.title: Cutting Board
quests.subtitle: Prepare ingredients
description: A Cutting Board chops ingredients with a knife - cabbage into leaves, wheat into dough, meat into cuts.
Next: a Cooking Pot to cook meals.

quests.title: Cooking Pot
quests.subtitle: Cook your meals
description: A Cooking Pot cooks soups, stews, and rice by holding ingredients over a heat source.
Next: grow some Cabbage.

quests.title: Cabbage
quests.subtitle: Grow a crop
description: Plant Cabbage Seeds in tilled soil. Cabbage is the base of many Farmer's Delight meals.
Next: cook your first Vegetable Soup.

quests.title: Vegetable Soup
quests.subtitle: Your first meal
description: Cook cabbage, onion, and carrot in a Cooking Pot to make Vegetable Soup. Meals give better nourishment than raw food.
Next: a Skillet to fry.

quests.title: Skillet
quests.subtitle: Fry food
description: A Skillet fries ingredients in a cooking pot for richer meals like Bacon and Eggs.
Next: a Stove for efficient cooking.

quests.title: Stove
quests.subtitle: Cooking station
description: A Stove heats multiple pots and pans at once and cooks faster than a campfire.
Next: cook Fried Rice.

quests.title: Fried Rice
quests.subtitle: A complex meal
description: Cook Rice with onion, egg, and vegetables to make Fried Rice - a filling late-game meal.
Next: Organic Compost to fertilize crops.

quests.title: Organic Compost
quests.subtitle: Fertilize crops
description: Organic Compost speeds up crop growth and enriches rich soil for better harvests.
This completes the Farmer's Delight chapter.

quests.title: Tomato
quests.subtitle: Grow tomatoes
description: Tomatoes grow on vines and are a key ingredient in many meals.

quests.title: Onion
quests.subtitle: Grow onions
description: Onions add flavor to soups and stews.

quests.title: Rice
quests.subtitle: Grow rice
description: Rice grows in shallow water and is the base of rice dishes.

quests.title: Diamond Knife
quests.subtitle: Upgraded knife
description: A Diamond Knife harvests faster and lasts longer than flint.
